en_US: Whether the real entry page exists and executes
Whether initialization throws or stops early
Whether required resources and data load successfully
zh_CN: 入口页面是否真实存在并能执行
初始化脚本是否报错或提前中断
页面依赖的资源和数据是否加载成功

description.en_US: The app opens with no visible content or only a blank page.
description.zh_CN: 打开应用后看不到任何内容，或者只显示一个空白页面。

title.en_US: The page opens blank
title.zh_CN: 页面打开后是空白的

en_US: Whether initialization has an unresolved wait
Whether both success and failure clear loading state
Whether permission, database, or file failures enter a recoverable state
zh_CN: 初始化请求是否有未结束的等待
成功和失败分支是否都会关闭加载状态
授权、数据库或文件请求失败时是否进入可恢复状态

description.en_US: The loading state never finishes and content does not appear.
description.zh_CN: 加载动画一直不消失，等很久也没有出现内容。

title.en_US: The page keeps loading forever
title.zh_CN: 页面一直停在加载中

en_US: Whether published entry and asset paths match the editor
Whether anonymous and signed-in access match the feature
Whether published users lack required data or runtime permissions
zh_CN: 发布入口和资源路径是否与编辑环境一致
匿名访问和登录要求是否符合功能需要
发布用户是否缺少必要的数据或运行权限

description.en_US: The app works while editing but loses content or features through the published link.
description.zh_CN: 制作页面时可以使用，但通过发布链接打开后内容缺失或功能失效。

title.en_US: Works in editor but fails after publishing
title.zh_CN: 编辑时正常，发布后不正常

en_US: Whether target pages and links really exist
Whether relative paths use the micro-app root
Whether state and back paths survive navigation
zh_CN: 页面文件和链接目标是否真实存在
相对路径是否以当前微应用根目录为准
页面切换时状态和返回路径是否正确保留

description.en_US: Links, tabs, or back actions open the wrong page or cannot return.
description.zh_CN: 点击链接、标签页或返回按钮后，进入了错误页面或无法返回。

title.en_US: Navigation leads to missing content
title.zh_CN: 页面跳转后找不到内容

en_US: Size constraints for page containers, overlays, and scroll areas
Layout with long text, narrow screens, and varying data
Whether fixed and absolute positioning and stacking are appropriate
zh_CN: 页面容器、弹层和滚动区域的尺寸约束
长文字、窄窗口和不同数据量下的布局
固定定位、绝对定位和层级关系是否合理

description.en_US: Text, buttons, cards, or dialogs overlap and some content is cut off.
description.zh_CN: 文字、按钮、卡片或弹窗互相遮挡，部分内容看不完整。

title.en_US: Content is misaligned, covered, or overflowing
title.zh_CN: 内容错位、遮挡或超出页面

en_US: Horizontal overflow and untappable controls on small screens
Whether tables have card or grouped-list alternatives
Usability with drawers, safe areas, and the soft keyboard
zh_CN: 小屏下是否存在横向溢出和不可点击控件
表格是否提供卡片或分组列表替代
弹层、安全区和软键盘出现时的可操作性

description.en_US: Mobile has horizontal scrolling, tiny buttons, cramped tables, or keyboard obstruction.
description.zh_CN: 手机上出现横向滚动、按钮太小、表格挤压或输入框被键盘挡住。

title.en_US: The app is hard to use on mobile
title.zh_CN: 手机上显示或操作不方便

en_US: Clear hierarchy among headings, body, and helper text
Whether real labels fit buttons and badges
Whether icon assets, sizing, colors, and accessible names are correct
zh_CN: 标题、正文和辅助文字是否有清晰层级
按钮和标签在真实文案长度下是否完整
图标资源、尺寸、颜色和无障碍名称是否正确

description.en_US: Text has low contrast or poor sizing, labels are clipped, or icons are missing.
description.zh_CN: 文字对比度低、字号不合适、按钮文字被截断，或者图标没有显示。

title.en_US: Text or icons are hard to see
title.zh_CN: 文字或图标看不清楚

en_US: Whether charts use real data and correct calculations
Whether titles, units, legends, and time ranges are clear
Whether no-data cases show a real empty state
zh_CN: 图表是否使用真实数据并正确计算
标题、单位、图例和时间范围是否明确
无数据时是否显示真实空状态而不是假图表

description.en_US: Charts lack titles, units, or legends, show wrong values, or render fake empty charts.
description.zh_CN: 图表缺少标题、单位或图例，数值不对应，没数据时仍显示空图。

title.en_US: Charts are confusing or show no data
title.zh_CN: 图表看不懂或没有数据

en_US: Whether real listeners are bound to the current element
Whether dynamic lists use delegated events on a stable container
Whether overlays, disabled state, or duplicate nodes block clicks
zh_CN: 真实事件监听是否绑定到当前元素
动态列表是否使用稳定容器上的事件委托
遮罩层、禁用状态或重复节点是否拦截点击

description.en_US: Clicking a button, menu, list action, or tab produces no change or feedback.
description.zh_CN: 点击按钮、菜单、列表操作或标签页后，没有任何变化或反馈。

title.en_US: A button does nothing when clicked
title.zh_CN: 按钮点了没有反应

en_US: Whether field reading consistently gets real input
Whether required validation, empty values, and errors are correct
Whether submitting, success, and failure states recover
zh_CN: 字段取值方式是否一致且能读到真实输入
必填校验、空值处理和错误提示是否正确
提交中、提交成功和提交失败状态是否能恢复

description.en_US: Filled fields are treated as empty or the submit button remains unavailable.
description.zh_CN: 明明填写了内容，提交时仍提示为空，或者提交按钮一直不可用。

title.en_US: A completed form cannot be submitted
title.zh_CN: 填写表单后无法提交

en_US: Whether one state source controls opening and closing
Whether outside click, close, and back actions conflict
Whether bubbling or duplicate listeners cause reopening
zh_CN: 打开和关闭是否由同一份状态控制
点击外部、关闭按钮和返回操作是否互相冲突
事件冒泡或重复绑定是否导致立即重开

description.en_US: A dialog, menu, or side panel cannot close or immediately reopens.
description.zh_CN: 弹窗、下拉菜单或侧边面板打开后无法关闭，或者关闭后马上又出现。

title.en_US: A dialog or menu cannot be closed
title.zh_CN: 弹窗或菜单关不掉

en_US: Whether events or components initialize more than once
Whether submission has disabled and concurrency guards
Whether listeners and temporary state are cleaned up
zh_CN: 是否重复绑定事件或重复初始化组件
提交期间是否有明确禁用和并发保护
完成或销毁时是否清理监听和临时状态

description.en_US: One click creates duplicate records, notifications, or tasks.
description.zh_CN: 点击一次却新增多条记录、弹出多个提示，或者重复发送同一个任务。

title.en_US: One action runs multiple times
title.zh_CN: 点一次却执行了多次

en_US: Whether the page uses the real table and real table ID
Whether query results, selected fields, and rendering paths match
Whether permissions, filters, or empty-state checks hide data
zh_CN: 页面是否连接了真实数据表并使用真实表 ID
查询结果、返回字段和页面读取路径是否一致
权限、筛选条件或空状态判断是否错误隐藏数据

description.en_US: The database has records but lists, cards, or statistics show nothing.
description.zh_CN: 数据库中已经有内容，但列表、卡片或统计区域没有显示。

title.en_US: The page is empty even though data exists
title.zh_CN: 明明有数据，页面却显示为空

en_US: Whether search and filters affect the current data source
Whether query conditions and field names match real data
Whether clearing, no-results, and failure states work
zh_CN: 搜索和筛选是否真正作用于当前数据源
查询条件和字段名称是否与真实数据一致
清除条件、无结果和请求失败状态是否正确

description.en_US: Keywords or filters do not change results or show incorrect content.
description.zh_CN: 输入关键词或切换筛选条件后，结果没有变化或显示了错误内容。

title.en_US: Search or filters do not work
title.zh_CN: 搜索或筛选没有效果

en_US: Whether sort fields and directions match the real API
Whether page, page size, and total stay in sync
Whether filter changes reset page and prevent stale responses
zh_CN: 排序字段和方向是否符合真实接口格式
页码、每页数量和总数是否正确同步
切换条件时是否重置页码并避免旧请求覆盖新结果

description.en_US: Sorting or paging causes duplicates, missing rows, wrong order, or incorrect page counts.
description.zh_CN: 切换排序或翻页后出现重复、遗漏、顺序错误，或者页数不准确。

title.en_US: Sorting or pagination is incorrect
title.zh_CN: 排序或翻页结果不对

en_US: Whether statistics use the same real data and conditions as lists
Whether numeric values, nulls, and time ranges are handled
Whether create, edit, and delete refresh statistics
zh_CN: 统计是否基于与列表相同的真实数据和条件
数值类型、空值和时间范围是否正确处理
新增、编辑和删除后是否同步刷新统计

description.en_US: Summary numbers, charts, and detailed records disagree.
description.zh_CN: 顶部数字、图表和列表明细显示的结果不一致。

title.en_US: Statistics do not match the records
title.zh_CN: 统计数字和明细对不上

en_US: Whether user data is persisted in MagicBase instead of page state only
Whether successful saves update from the server response
Whether failures are incorrectly shown as saved
zh_CN: 用户数据是否真正写入 MagicBase 而不是只保存在页面状态
保存成功后是否使用服务端返回结果更新页面
失败时是否错误显示为已保存

description.en_US: New or edited content appears briefly but disappears after reopening.
description.zh_CN: 刚新增或修改的内容当时能看到，但刷新或重新打开后消失。

title.en_US: Data disappears after refreshing
title.zh_CN: 刷新页面后刚才的数据没了

en_US: Whether the real table and fields exist
Whether submitted data contains only writable business fields
Whether required fields, types, and insert permission match the schema
zh_CN: 页面使用的数据表和字段是否真实存在
提交数据是否只包含允许写入的业务字段
必填字段、字段类型和新增权限是否符合当前表结构

description.en_US: Create or save fails, or the new item never appears in the list.
description.zh_CN: 点击新增或保存后提示失败，或者列表里没有新内容。

title.en_US: Creating new content keeps failing
title.zh_CN: 新增内容总是失败

en_US: Whether actions use the correct record ID and real table
Whether edit and delete permissions match the current user
Whether the UI applies real results instead of stale cache
zh_CN: 操作是否使用正确记录 ID 和真实数据表
编辑和删除权限是否符合当前用户身份
成功后页面是否使用真实结果更新而不是恢复旧缓存

description.en_US: Edits do not stick, deleted content returns, or only some records can be changed.
description.zh_CN: 编辑后没有变化，删除后又出现，或者只有部分内容可以操作。

title.en_US: Content cannot be edited or deleted
title.zh_CN: 内容无法修改或删除

en_US: Query the real schema and project memory; do not create fields in HTML
Confirm purpose, type, default, and access of new fields
If schema changes are needed, present a plan and old-data migration first
zh_CN: 先查询真实表结构和项目记忆，不要在页面中自行创建字段
确认新字段的用途、类型、默认值和读写权限
如需变更表结构，先展示计划和旧数据迁移方案并等待确认

description.en_US: The UI has a new feature, but saving lacks fields and old data no longer displays correctly.
description.zh_CN: 页面已经增加了新功能，但保存时缺字段，旧数据也无法正常显示。

title.en_US: A new feature is missing required fields
title.zh_CN: 新增功能后缺少需要填写的内容

en_US: Whether identity comes from the real signed-in runtime context
Whether identity-dependent apps disable anonymous mode
Whether identity failure blocks dependent actions with a clear error
zh_CN: 用户身份是否来自当前运行环境的真实登录信息
需要登录身份的应用是否禁止匿名运行
获取身份失败时是否停止相关操作并显示明确错误

description.en_US: Name, avatar, my data, or creator appears as another person, guest, or blank.
description.zh_CN: 用户名、头像、我的数据或创建人显示成其他人、访客或空白。

title.en_US: The page shows the wrong signed-in user
title.zh_CN: 页面显示的不是当前登录用户

en_US: Confirm whether data should be personal, department, organization, or public
Check real MagicBase row-read permissions rather than UI filtering only
Explain impact and wait for plan approval before permission changes
zh_CN: 确认用户期望是个人、部门、组织还是公开数据
检查真实 MagicBase 行级读取权限而不是只做前端过滤
权限调整前先说明影响范围并通过计划等待确认

description.en_US: A personal view exposes records submitted or saved by other users.
description.zh_CN: 本应只显示自己的内容，却能看到其他用户提交或保存的数据。

title.en_US: I can see other users' private data
title.zh_CN: 我看到了不该看到的其他人数据

en_US: Whether UI actions compare stable user IDs with the real creator field
Whether backend row edit and delete are creator-only
Do not treat hidden buttons as secure permission
zh_CN: 页面操作是否根据稳定用户 ID 和真实创建人字段判断
检查后端行级编辑和删除权限是否限制到创建人
不要把隐藏按钮当成安全权限

description.en_US: Records meant to be owner-managed can be changed or deleted by others.
description.zh_CN: 本应只有创建人能操作的数据，却被其他用户修改或删除。

title.en_US: Other users can edit or delete my data
title.zh_CN: 别人可以修改或删除我的数据

en_US: Whether admin links depend on the real admin result
Whether every admin page checks before loading data
Whether underlying data permissions are protected beyond hiding links
zh_CN: 管理入口是否根据真实管理员结果隐藏
每个管理页面是否在加载数据前单独校验
底层数据权限是否同步限制，而不是只隐藏页面入口

description.en_US: Regular users can access admin links, statistics, exports, or sensitive data.
description.zh_CN: 普通用户能看到管理入口、统计、导出或其他敏感数据。

title.en_US: Regular users can open admin pages
title.zh_CN: 普通用户也能进入管理页面

en_US: Whether model list and selection are really available
Whether requests include a valid model and required permission
Whether timeout, denial, and service errors provide retryable feedback
zh_CN: 模型列表和当前选择是否真实可用
请求是否包含有效模型并具备必要授权
超时、拒绝授权和服务错误是否给出可重试反馈

description.en_US: Generate, analyze, or summarize actions fail without returning results.
description.zh_CN: 点击生成、分析或总结后提示失败，没有返回任何结果。

title.en_US: AI generation keeps failing
title.zh_CN: 智能生成一直失败

en_US: Whether both completion and errors end loading
Whether cancel, retry, and unmount clean old requests
Whether partial and new results are incorrectly concatenated
zh_CN: 流式完成和错误状态是否都能结束加载
取消、重试和页面关闭时是否清理旧请求
部分结果和新结果是否被错误拼接

description.en_US: Only part of the result appears, loading never ends, or retry duplicates content.
description.zh_CN: 内容只生成了一部分，加载状态不结束，重新操作还会重复内容。

title.en_US: Generation stops halfway
title.zh_CN: 生成到一半就停了

en_US: Whether agent list and selection come from the real runtime
Whether complex tasks create a new topic and send a real message
Whether started, running, completed, and failed states are visible
zh_CN: 员工列表和选中员工是否来自真实运行环境
复杂任务是否创建了新话题并发送真实消息
任务开始、进行中、完成和失败状态是否可见

description.en_US: Submitting to an agent creates no visible task, result, or progress.
description.zh_CN: 选择员工并提交任务后，没有创建任务、没有结果，也不知道是否开始。

title.en_US: A selected agent does not run the task
title.zh_CN: 选择员工后任务没有执行

en_US: Whether the file is really uploaded or saved and accessible
Whether the task correctly references the real file
Whether long or multi-step analysis uses an appropriate task workflow
zh_CN: 文件是否真实上传或保存并能被当前项目访问
发送任务时是否正确引用了真实文件
长文件或多步骤分析是否交给合适的任务流程而不是页面直接处理

description.en_US: A selected or uploaded file is ignored or produces unrelated analysis.
description.zh_CN: 文件已经选择或上传，但智能分析没有读取文件内容或返回了无关结果。

title.en_US: An uploaded file is not analyzed
title.zh_CN: 上传文件后没有被分析

en_US: Whether initialization repeats data requests or serializes independent work
Whether lists load unnecessary full details
Whether static content, user actions, and background refresh are separated
zh_CN: 初始化是否重复请求相同数据或串行等待无关任务
列表是否加载了不需要的全部详情
静态内容、用户操作和后台刷新是否合理分开

description.en_US: Initial load, tab switching, or returning to a list takes too long.
description.zh_CN: 首次打开、切换标签或返回列表时需要等待很久。

title.en_US: Opening or switching pages is slow
title.zh_CN: 页面打开或切换很慢

en_US: Whether too many records are fetched or rendered at once
Whether paging, filters, and sorting operate on the real source
Whether repeated calculations, renders, or listeners are excessive
zh_CN: 是否一次渲染或请求过多记录
分页、筛选和排序是否在真实数据源执行
重复计算、重复渲染和无效事件监听是否过多

description.en_US: Scrolling, search, filters, or details slow down as records grow.
description.zh_CN: 记录增加后滚动、搜索、筛选或打开详情明显变慢。

title.en_US: The page becomes slow with more data
title.zh_CN: 数据一多页面就很卡

en_US: Whether old selection and loading state reset after switching
Whether stale requests overwrite newer results
Whether caches and listeners are scoped to the current page, record, and user
zh_CN: 切换目标后是否重置旧的选择和加载状态
旧请求是否会覆盖新请求结果
缓存和监听是否按当前页面、记录和用户正确隔离

description.en_US: Switching records, pages, or users still shows previous data or state.
description.zh_CN: 切换记录、页面或账号后，仍然看到上一次的数据或状态。

title.en_US: Old content remains after switching
title.zh_CN: 切换页面后还是显示旧内容

en_US: Whether real actions have loading, success, error, and disabled states
Whether errors explain what happened and the next step
Whether failures are retryable instead of leaving the page stuck
zh_CN: 所有真实操作是否有 loading、success、error 和 disabled 状态
错误文案是否说明发生了什么和下一步操作
失败后页面是否可以重试而不是永久卡住

description.en_US: Nothing changes or errors only appear in the console, leaving the user unsure what to do.
description.zh_CN: 点击后没有变化，或者只在控制台报错，用户不知道该怎么处理。

title.en_US: An action fails without explanation
title.zh_CN: 操作失败了，但页面没有说明

promptTemplates.en_US:
Please inspect and fix the "{{title}}" issue in the current micro app.

What the user sees: {{description}}

First read MICRO-APP.md and inspect the existing pages, real interactions, and real data. Do not guess from the symptom alone.

Focus on:
{{checks}}

Requirements:
- Change only what is related to this issue and preserve existing features and data.
- If the fix changes major functionality, file structure, MagicBase schema, or permissions, present a micro_app_plan and wait for confirmation first.
- Do not create buttons, charts, filters, or permission effects that do not really work.
- Verify the user-visible result and explain the cause, changes, and verification result.
promptTemplates.zh_CN:
请检查并修复当前微应用的「{{title}}」问题。

用户看到的现象：{{description}}

请先读取当前项目的 MICRO-APP.md，并结合现有页面、真实交互和真实数据定位原因，不要只根据现象猜测。

重点检查：
{{checks}}

处理要求：
- 只修改与问题有关的实现，保留已有功能和数据。
- 如果涉及较大功能调整、文件结构、MagicBase 表结构或权限变化，先通过 micro_app_plan 展示方案并等待确认。
- 不要生成不能实际使用的按钮、图表、筛选或权限效果。
- 修改后验证用户能看到的结果，并说明原因、修改内容和验证结果。
